item.title: Trump says he has 'no problem' with Russian oil tanker bringing relief to Cuba despite blockade
item.summary: President Donald Trump said he has "no problem" with a Russian oil tanker off the coast of Cuba delivering relief to the island, which has been brought to its knees by a U.S. oil blockade.

item.title: Trump weighing all options on Iran's Kharg Island
item.summary: The president said the U.S. could "take the oil in Iran" and that he was considering sending U.S. forces to seize Kharg Island's oil terminal.

item.title: Central Haitian town descends into fire and bloodshed from gang warfare
item.summary: Violence erupted in the central Haitian town of Petite-Rivière de l'Artibonite early Sunday morning as a powerful gang warred with a vigilante group.

item.title: Philanthropy in science has little oversight. Jeffrey Epstein exploited that
item.summary: A large share of science funding comes through philanthropy, with little legal or public scrutiny. This lack of oversight allowed Jeffrey Epstein to cultivate scientists and launder his reputation.

item.title: Trump administration cuts turned rural towns into sitting ducks for disasters
item.summary: The Trump administration has delayed billions of dollars for projects to protect Americans from floods, wildfires and hurricanes. Local leaders are increasingly anxious.

item.title: China's chatbot industry is fiercely competing for customers. Cue the freebies
item.summary: Chinese AI companies are focused less on being cutting edge and more on attracting customers. That means holiday promotions, and making chatbots useful in everyday life.

item.title: As birthright citizenship goes to Supreme Court, here's how Americans feel about it
item.summary: The Supreme Court will hear arguments Wednesday on whether all children born in the United States can continue to automatically receive citizenship.

item.title: The Final Four is set with UConn stunning Duke to join Illinois, Arizona and Michigan
item.summary: The Huskies beat Duke with a 3-pointer from the logo with 0.4 seconds left by Braylon Mullins, who grew up just outside of Indianapolis.

item.title: He's the voice of romantasy audiobooks' biggest heartthrobs. He's never been busier
item.summary: From Rhysand in A Court of Thorns and Roses to Kingfisher in "Fae and Alchemy," Anthony Palmini is a voiceover star for romantasy's bestsellers — a book genre that continues to explode.

item.title: How much protein do you need? Here's how to personalize your optimal intake
item.summary: The Dietary Guidelines released this year recommend higher levels of this essential nutrient. But protein needs are personal. Here's how to assess yours.
